description: This file defines a mock class 'GstCapabilitiesMock' for testing purposes, which implements the 'IGstCapabilities' interface. It includes mock methods for retrieving supported MIME types and checking MIME type support, used in media capabilities testing within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesMock
classes.description: A mock class for IGstCapabilities used in unit testing to simulate media capabilities behavior.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Mock method to return a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Mock method to check if a specific MIME type is supported.
